name: AWS Transit Gateway
overview: AWS Transit Gateway is a regional network hub connecting VPCs and on-premises networks through attachments and route tables.
examSignals: Hub-and-spoke routing among many VPCs/VPN/DX: Transit Gateway
Simple one-to-one VPC peering: VPC Peering may be sufficient
